character.motivation: Collects torn kite paper and wants a reason for the whole valley to look up together.
character.voice: Fast, literal, delighted by odd comparisons.
character.backstory: Pip started flying patched paper over the meadow while older residents were still arguing about the old road. A kite gives people on opposite sides of the dispute something they can work on together.
character.quest_hook: Help Pip and Kit plan a kite day. Ask Aya where the group can fly without disturbing the nests.

dialogue.introduction: I made a kite shaped like a fish. It keeps trying to swim into the mud.
dialogue.friendship: My best kite tore on the first flight. Now the paper's patched, everybody asks where I got the pattern.
dialogue.supper: I set a kite on the empty chair. Iona asked if I'd make one for the next supper too.
dialogue.hearing: They used to tell me that part of the pond was bottomless. I think they wanted me to stop asking.
dialogue.favorite_gift: The petals look like paper I can actually fold!
dialogue.disliked_gift: A fish doesn't work as a kite weight. I already asked Ren.

routine.home_context: Chose a house with a clear walk south to the green where kites can get above the trees.
